text:
I could not confirm which desktop patch introduced the Tiki Totem. Three lookups (a web search, the Terraria Wiki's Tiki page, and the Desktop version history page) gave the item's description but no patch number, and the version history page does not mention it at all. The Tiki Totem is a pet-summoning item sold by the Witch Doctor in the Jungle during Hardmode that summons a Tiki Spirit.

CONFIDENCE: 10

Sources:
- https://terraria.wiki.gg/wiki/Tiki
- https://terraria.wiki.gg/wiki/Desktop
